critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing note (not in scope of this round): /ora is wrapped in <PrivateRoute> in App.jsx:386, which redirects to /login when there is no aurem_token in localStorage. This means the PinPad in OraDirect.jsx is only reachable to a user who already has a (possibly stale) app JWT. The per-user personal-PIN feature functionally works for the intended admin/founder shortcut path (login normally, then use /ora), but the PinPad-as-entry-point flow described in the review request is effectively unreachable for a fresh visitor unless the token is manually cleared while on /ora (ora-logout button, verified working). If the intent is truly public/PIN-gated entry, the PrivateRoute wrapper on this route should be removed. Not a regression; predates this round.
OraDirect.jsx line 122 uses .catch(() => setToken(null)) but does not clear other localStorage keys (aurem_user, aurem_active_project) on token invalidation; low-risk UX inconsistency.

sanitizeError.js pattern /\b[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*Exception\b/ will match legitimate user text containing e.g. 'RulesException' inside a valid, non-stack sentence. Acceptable trade-off given the pattern's protective intent.
